Stacks by GTM team size › Solo founder

1 GTM person

Solo founder: AI GTM stack for 1 GTM person, about $41/mo

About $41/mo + €19 Waalaxy for our recommended stack, estimated from published list prices as of 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-05 (per tool). Assumptions: 1 GTM person, 1 LinkedIn account, light volume. Hunter's free plan (50 credits/mo) caps how many new emails you can find; move up when you outgrow it. Monthly billing, entry tiers; Carrd is priced yearly ÷ 12. Actual cost depends on your usage, billing period, taxes and add-ons.

Who this is for

One person doing all of go-to-market: you are the founder, the seller and the marketer. Your goal is the first repeatable customers, not a machine.

Recommended stack (estimate)

One tool per job, no paid overlap. Each pick weighs two things: its value score and whether it fits a team of this size, judged from reviews by companies of similar size and from enterprise-readiness evidence. The value score is a category-wide number based on each tool's lowest published price (often a free plan), so a tool can be "best in category" and still not be the pick at this size. "Best in category" means the highest value score (ties included) among all tools we list for that use case.

  • Warm network & referrals. Spreadsheet or notes app you already own. Message everyone you know who fits your ICP first; no tool is needed to do this.
  • ICP & positioning. Customer conversations plus a one-page doc. We list no paid tool for this job: talk to buyers first.

Use cases that matter at this size

  • List building & lead data
  • Enrichment & verification
  • Outbound email / sequencing
  • LinkedIn outreach
  • Landing pages & websites
  • Newsletters
  • Web analytics

Skip for now

  • Signals & intent data (RB2B, PostHog, Common Room). Paid intent and visitor-identification tools tell you who to talk to. Until hand-built outbound gets replies, you have nobody to prioritize.
  • AI SDR / agentic SDR. These are contact-sales products. An agent cannot fix messaging that does not work by hand yet.
  • Social scheduling, search and content tools, design/video, community. Useful later; none of them is needed to get the first customers. Free Search Console is worth setting up when you publish.
  • AEO (AI search visibility) tools. No AI-search demand to measure yet, and warm leads and outbound come first. Revisit when content gets traffic.

What is included in the recommended stack?
